---

**Basis for each verdict:**

**RQDIFF-1 / RQDIFF-2:** `plugins/agent/build/lib/summary.sh` gains an `elif` branch that fires when `terminated_reason` is `no_done_sentinel` or `router_out_of_turns`, `files_count` is 0, and `scope_violation_mode` is not `true`. It calls `emit_event "build.discrepancy.detected"` with `terminated_reason=$terminated_reason`. `plugins/agent/build/tests/build-test.sh` adds DSDIFF-1 and DSDIFF-2 sections that call the function in a clean repo (zero uncommitted changes), assert the event is emitted, and assert `data.terminated_reason` matches the value passed. Both tests run in the 894-pass suite.

**RQDIFF-3:** The `done_sentinel` branch in `summary.sh` is unchanged — both `build.discrepancy.detected` and `build.diff.empty_after_done_sentinel` are still emitted. The new DSDIFF-3 test section explicitly guards this, confirming the guard would catch removal of either event.

**RQEND-1:** `tests/unit/route-loop-terminated-reasons-test.sh` (new file) extracts every literal `_ROUTE_LOOP_TERMINATED_REASON="…"` assignment from `route.sh` (yielding `done_sentinel`, `no_done_sentinel`, `signal`, `router_budget_exceeded`, `router_config_error`, `router_rate_limited`, `router_timeout`) and every non-empty `printf -v "$reason_var"` string from `_router_rc_classify` in `router-rc-classify.sh` (yielding `router_rate_limited`, `router_out_of_turns`, `router_timeout`, `router_oom_kill`, `router_config_error`, `router_rc_nonzero`). The union is checked bidirectionally against comment tokens. The updated comment lists all ten values with no shorthand, matching the union exactly. The test passes in the full suite.

**RQLOCK-1:** The `summary.sh` diff reads existing reason strings `no_done_sentinel` and `router_out_of_turns`; it assigns none. The `route.sh` diff is comment-only. No new `_ROUTE_LOOP_TERMINATED_REASON` value appears in any changed file.

**RQLOCK-2:** The `git diff` for `core/router/route.sh` shows only the three comment lines changed (the `_ROUTE_LOOP_TERMINATED_REASON` listing); no code lines were touched.

**RQLOCK-3:** `scripts/lib/router-rc-classify.sh` is absent from the diff entirely.

**RQLOCK-4:** `tests/unit/route-one-call-per-try-test.sh` is absent from the diff; the DSLOCK-3 assertion in the new test file also verifies this mechanically at run time.
